solutionSql:
SELECT id, status
FROM shipment_scans_large
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 5;

rules.howSolved: ORDER BY id DESC puts the largest id first.
ORDER BY id DESC on the primary key; EXPLAIN on sample shows Limit over an Index Scan Backward using shipment_scans_large_pkey, so the primary key index supplies the order.

notes: The EXPLAIN check was run on the sample dataset only. The result columns are id (integer) and status (text), as the ticket specifies.
